methods.outer_ring: d=min(x,y,31-x,31-y)=0; visible alpha>0; raw RGB Euclidean distance to #3B2A20 <=40. Fully opaque alpha==255 reported separately; empty denominator=null.
methods.pattern: center [5:27,5:27] (22x22); alpha>0 AND raw RGB Euclidean distance to #FAF2DC >40; coverage denominator=484.
methods.luminance_and_contrast: sRGB linearized at 0.04045; Rec.709 weights .2126/.7152/.0722; WCAG=(max(L1,L2)+.05)/(min(L1,L2)+.05); icon pattern uses mean relative luminance.
methods.primary_colors: raw visible full-icon RGB, floor(channel/16), 16 levels per channel; bins with fraction >=.03. Pattern-only palette also reported.
methods.rgb_mad: mean(abs(raw RGB A - raw RGB B))/255 over all 32x32x3 samples, including RGB behind alpha=0.
methods.mask_difference: 1 - intersection/union of center pattern masks; empty union=0.
methods.blur: convert to RGB first, BOX downsample 32->16, BILINEAR upsample 16->32, then raw RGB MAD/255.
methods.nearest: Each target compared with the other 19 same-version targets and the 6 current polished references. Separate nearest/minima per metric; all pair records retain all three differences. Global pairs exclude reference/reference.
methods.sect_band: d=min(x,y,31-x,31-y) in {2,3}, raw RGB mean over alpha>0; sect matrices use three active/buff icons per sect; diagonal=min distinct same-sect pair, off-diagonal=min nine cross-sect pairs. Passive gold frames separate.
methods.lighting: Center pattern-mask geometry centroid and linear-luminance-weighted centroid; offset=weighted minus geometry; image x grows right/y grows down; upper-left iff dx<0 AND dy<0. Also record offset from canvas (15.5,15.5).
methods.hud_contrast: Per visible icon pixel compare alpha-composited icon luminance with exact same-coordinate scene+panel+normal/active-slot background, before labels. Normal summary=arithmetic mean of slots 0..3 including reference spirit_bolt; active slot 4 separate.
methods.hud_band_distance: Euclidean distance between mean displayed band RGB and same-coordinate slot-background mean RGB; additionally mean of per-pixel RGB distances. Band uses same d={2,3}.
methods.background: far native-size x/y tiling from (0,0), mid native-size horizontal tiling with bottom alignment; source crop only, no background scaling.
methods.preview_transparency: RGBA icons composited over labeled solid paper/light/dark grounds or their actual HUD slot; all saved previews opaque RGB.
methods.checksums: MD5 of metrics_r1.json itself is printed on stdout, outside the JSON, to avoid a circular self-checksum.

passive_shared_gold_frame.note: Passive frames share a gold identity cue; excluded from sect discrimination matrix.
